test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Have you written the right answer?

options.text: Has the right answer been written by you?
Was the right answer been written by you?
Have the right answer been written by you?
Has the right answer being written by you?

solution:
The correct answer is **"Has the right answer been written by you?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Present Perfect Tense and Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Perfect Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Subject is "you" and object is "the right answer" in active voice.
 
• So, the subject is "the right answer" and object is "you" in passive voice.
 
• Structure__:
 __
 
• Has/have + Subject + V3 + Object? (Active Voice)__
 
• Has/have + Object + been + V3 + by + Subject __(Passive Voice)__
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Has Disha arranged the things? *(Active Voice)
 
• *Have the things been arranged by Disha?** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

​​Correct sentence: *Has the right answer been written by you?*
